compose.config_validation: passed with candidate, worker, and standard overlays using a synthetic runtime-password placeholder; no containers were started

migration_prerequisites: migrations 529 and 530 must be applied before use
read_transaction: SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY with 15-second statement and 3-second lock timeouts
remaining_boundary: This entry point supports four deterministic AI-summary types only. Existing synthesis CLIs and other agent task writers still use legacy paths; the one-shot service is not enabled by default.
runtime_database_identity: KOKONUT_RUNTIME_USER/PASSWORD required; source transaction is read-only and time-bounded
stdout: summary content and source row IDs omitted; only summary ID, status, and replay marker are printed
write_path: signed worker adapter with exact request replay and source-reference attachment
